quests.independentSemanticReview: Northern Felwood-border ruined shrine, wolf-men and possible explanatory Tome preserved. Progress describes blessed pages rather than an ordinary book; completion calls for further Scythe investigation. Objective stays null because Shrine of Aessina conflicts with installed Forest Song. Other fields do not state that return location.

Predecessor, gradually failing efforts, disappearance and the speaker's lack of knowledge remain qualified. Melyria to Thyn'tel at Warrior's Terrace in Darnassus is the distinct next stage. No fabricated Progress.
Effects correctly means personal belongings. Chest in Sentinels' bunkhouse, journal AND key return, reasons for departure, possible return, earned trust, and disbelief in a bad end remain distinct.

Ratchet is the only Barrens port. Trading-vessel explanation remains probable; southeast road through Ashenvale, Horde patrol danger and port safety preserved. Dizzywig is the recipient; race/name markers retained.

Old passage on Black Osprey and the lack of contrary ledger evidence support presumed safe arrival. Ruzzgot travel remains possible. Boat to Booty Bay and Caravaneer recipient preserved; impatient goblin voice retained. English long ago correctly controls over UA recently.

Caravan self-advertising aside, night elf priestess, northward split, Darkshire records clerk, jungle warning and qualified possible useful knowledge retained. Clerk Daltry, not Jonathan or Thyn'tel, receives this stage.

Daltry has no lodging record. Wolf-men, Calor's string of heads and Carevin family hunters preserved. Jonathan refuses to ask forgiveness for suspicion and demands answers; the hostile voice is not reversed.

True-sounding story, incomplete motive understanding, results over understanding, south mine and qualified first-known appearance retained. Evidence search returns to Jonathan; danger warning and limited containment effort, rather than a promised universal cure, preserved.

Jonathan bears no ill will and sends the player to Thyn'tel in Darnassus. High priestess is Velinde's friend and remains distinct from the goddess who bestowed the Scythe. Lost custody, deferred concern and gratitude preserved.

Shindrell's report covers the coast and Astranaar forests. Suspected corruption remains uncertain. Kayneth receives the Note at Forest Song in eastern Nightsong Woods; brave/keen sentinel praise retained.

Near destruction rather than total annihilation, red-dragon retaliation, east of Whelgar's Excavation and northeast of Menethil preserved. Eight banners; Nek'rosh the son and Nekros the slain father remain distinct. Exclusion473 remains metadata, not an invented live claim.

Fleet at current location, near capture of Hillsbrad, mountain remnants and northeast activity retained. Four Attack Plans destroyed only after critical information is noted. Ironforge target, absent enslaved red-drake army and costly gambit retained.

Attack plans are closer to execution; Dun Algaz cuts off reinforcement. Fight to catapults, ignite using tinder, then kill Nek'rosh. Progress is first catapult and completion is ignition; these object states are not Captain's head turn-in. UA older opening is not imported.

After burned catapults, kill Chieftain and return his Head to Stoutfist. Possible inability to recover remains uncertain. Menethil Harbor safety, meritorious race and Ironforge reward preserved. Metadata prerequisite465 and catapult-to-Captain identities retained.
